description: This file implements the RunC container management class, including container lifecycle operations (create, start, stop, delete), state retrieval, and configuration handling, utilizing the runc command-line tool. It defines classes for container info, configuration, and the runner that executes runc commands, as well as container administrator and container classes.

classes.name: Runner
classes.description: Handles execution of runc commands such as create, exec, delete, and state, and manages command options and output parsing.

classes.name: Runner::Info
classes.description: Represents the container state information, including PID and status.

classes.name: Runner::Config
classes.description: Represents the container configuration, including environment variables.

classes.name: Runner::Config::ProcessData
classes.description: Holds process-specific configuration data, such as environment variables.

classes.name: RunCContainer
classes.description: Represents a container managed via runc, providing lifecycle operations and resource metrics.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new container with specified ID and bundle path.

methods.name: Exec
methods.description: Executes a command inside the container.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the container.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists all containers managed by runc.

methods.name: InheritHostEnvironmentVariables
methods.description: Inherits environment variables from host based on config file.

methods.name: InternalPurge
methods.description: Stops and removes the container if it is running.

methods.name: Pid
methods.description: Returns the container's process ID if running.

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: Memory
methods.description: Returns memory usage info of the container.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Returns CPU resource info of the container.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns network interfaces associated with the container.
